title.narrative: Mali Revival: Women and Youth for the Agroecological Development of Local Communities
Rinascita Mali: donne e giovani per lo sviluppo agroecologico delle comunità locali

description.narrative: Il progetto “Rinascita Mali” si propone di favorire la sicurezza alimentare e nutrizionale di giovani e donne attraverso l’agroecologia migliorando anche il nesso ambiente-nutrizione-salute-lavoro. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, Rinascita Mali garantirà ai beneficiari produzioni agro-alimentari diversificate ed ecologicamente sostenibili (R1 - Purpose code 31161 Produzioni agricole alimentari), attraverso il sostegno a comunità e famiglie per migliorare le produzioni e la trasformazione agroalimentare; favorirà l’inclusione socio-economica di donne e giovani (R2 - Purpose code 31120 Sviluppo dell’agricoltura) attraverso l’accompagnamento allo sviluppo di microimprese, alla creazione di un mercato dedicato solo ai prodotti agro-ecologici, all’empowerment di donne e ragazze, all’educazione ambientale e agro-ecologica nelle scuole; e preverrà la malnutrizione attraverso l’adozione di corrette pratiche di alimentazione e nutrizione dirette alle donne incinte e allattanti e bambini sotto i 5 anni (R3 - Purpose code 12240 Nutrizione di base) attraverso indagini CAP e diagnostici comunitari sulla malnutrizione, la formazione e l’accompagnamento del personale di salute, degli attori comunitari di salute e dei produttori locali, la sensibilizzazione e l’animazione comunitaria per l’introduzione delle buone pratiche alimentari, e campagne permanenti e uso di ICT. In questo modo, Rinascita Mali contribuisce al raggiungimento degli OSS 2 Sconfiggere la fame (target 2.1, 2.2. e 2.4), OSS 8 Lavoro dignitoso e crescita economica (target 8.2, 8.3) e OSS 15 Vita sulla terra (target 15.3) supportando i beneficiari, giovani, donne, bambini e stakeholder del settore agricoltura e salute. Questo approccio multidimensionale contribuirà a ridurre la fame, favorendo l'accesso a un’alimentazione sicura, nutriente e sufficiente (Policy Objective OCSE/DAC Nutrizione), a garantire sistemi di produzione alimentare sostenibili e pratiche agricole resilienti che aumentino la produttività e la produzione ma al contempo preservino le risorse naturali (Policy Objective OCSE/DAC Aid to environment), combattano la desertificazione e supportino la mitigazione e l’adattamento al cambiamento climatico (Rio Markers Desertification, Climate change – mitigation e adaptation). Inoltre, il progetto supporta a tutto campo l’equità d genere e si impegna per l’empowerment di donne e ragazze anche con attività dedicate (Policy Objective OCSE/DAC Gender Equality). Per raggiungere questi obiettivi, Rinascita Mali ha sviluppato un ampio partenariato con l’ONG TAMAT, capofila con anni di esperienza in pratiche agro-ecologiche e sviluppo di microimprese, in Mali e in Sahel, l’ONG Progetto Mondo, e i partner maliani Caritas, Le Tonus, Haut Conseil des Maliens de l'Extérieur (HCME), Fédération Nationale pour le Développement des Jeunes Filles pour leur Autonomisation (FENAJFA), e l’Association Subaahi Gumo (ASG), a cui si aggiunge il sostegno degli stakeholder quali le autorità locali, OSC, le scuole coinvolte nel progetto e l’Università di Perugia, Dipartimento 3 A che ha già espresso la volontà di continuare ad accompagnare Tamat e i beneficiari nello sviluppo dell’agroecologia.

"Rinascita Mali" project aims to promote food and nutrition security of young people and women through agroecology, also improving the environment-nutrition-health-work nexus. To achieve this goal, Rinascita Mali will guarantee beneficiaries diversified and ecologically sustainable crops and agri-food production (R1 - Purpose code 31161 Food crop production), through support to communities and families to improve -food production and processing; promote the socio-economic inclusion of women and young people (R2 - Purpose code 31120 Agricultural development) through supporting the development of micro-enterprises, the creation of a market dedicated only to agro-ecological products, the empowerment of women and girls, environmental and agroecological education in schools; and prevent malnutrition through the adoption of proper feeding and nutrition practices directed at pregnant and lactating women and children under 5 years of age (R3 - Purpose code 12240 Basic Nutrition) through CAP and community diagnostic surveys on malnutrition, training and accompaniment of health personnel, community health actors and local producers, awareness-raising and community animation for the introduction of good food practices, and permanent campaigns and use of ICT. Thus, Rinascita Mali contributes to the achievement of SDG 2 No Hunger (targets 2.1, 2.2. and 2.4), SDG 8 Decent work and economic growth (targets 8.2, 8.3), and SDG 15 Life on land (target 15.3) by supporting beneficiaries, young people, women, children and stakeholders in the agriculture and health sector. This multidimensional approach will contribute to reducing hunger by promoting access to safe, nutritious and sufficient food (OECD Policy Objective/DAC Nutrition), ensuring sustainable food production systems and resilient agricultural practices that increase productivity and production while conserving natural resources (OECD Policy Objective/DAC Aid to environment), combat desertification and support mitigation and adaptation to climate change (Rio Markers Desertification, Climate change – mitigation and adaptation). In addition, the project mainstreams gender equality across the project and is committed to the empowerment of women and girls also with dedicated activities (OECD Policy Objective/DAC Gender Equality). To achieve these goals, Rinascita Mali has developed a broad partnership with the NGO TAMAT (with more than 30 years of experience in agro-ecological practices and development of micro-enterprises, in Mali and the Sahel) as lead partner, the NGO Progetto Mondo, and the Malian partners Caritas, Le Tonus, Haut Conseil des Maliens de l'Extérieur (HCME), Fédération Nationale pour le Développement des Jeunes Filles pour leur Autonomisation (FENAJFA), and the Association Subaahi Gumo (ASG), to which is added the support of stakeholders such as local authorities, local CSOs, schools involved in the project and the University of Perugia, Department 3 A which has already expressed its willingness to continue to accompany Tamat and the beneficiaries in the development of agroecology.

tag.narrative: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls
Achieve higher levels of economic productivity through diversification, technological upgrading and innovation, including through a focus on high-value added and labour-intensive sectors
By 2030, combat desertification, restore degraded land and soil, including land affected by desertification, drought and floods, and strive to achieve a land degradation-neutral world

By 2030, double the agricultural productivity and incomes of small-scale food producers, in particular women, indigenous peoples, family farmers, pastoralists and fishers, including through secure and equal access to land, other productive resources and inputs, knowledge, financial services, markets and opportunities for value addition and non-farm employment

By 2030, end all forms of malnutrition, including achieving, by 2025, the internationally agreed targets on stunting and wasting in children under 5 years of age, and address the nutritional needs of adolescent girls, pregnant and lactating women and older persons
By 2030, end hunger and ensure access by all people, in particular the poor and people in vulnerable situations, including infants, to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round

By 2030, ensure sustainable food production systems and implement resilient agricultural practices that increase productivity and production, that help maintain ecosystems, that strengthen capacity for adaptation to climate change, extreme weather, drought, flooding and other disasters and that progressively improve land and soil quality
End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture
Ensure women’s full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making in political, economic and public life
Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all
Protect, restore and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems, sustainably manage forests, combat desertification, and halt and reverse land degradation and halt biodiversity loss

Undertake reforms to give women equal rights to economic resources, as well as access to ownership and control over land and other forms of property, financial services, inheritance and natural resources, in accordance with national laws
